name: Falling For Al
source:
When you find yourself smitten with someone, you sometimes overlook the obvious. That's just what boyfails do.

[From [url=https://jmjerbear.itch.io/falling-for-al]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你对某个人神魂颠倒时，有时难免会对显而易见的事实视而不见——恋爱脑的废柴男孩们可不就是这样嘛。

[摘自[url=https://jmjerbear.itch.io/falling-for-al]itch.io[/url]]
